about.blurb: Desktop client of the 1f6s initiative: transcodes locally with the bundled ffmpeg, following the 1f6s eight-level compression spec.
about.spec_updated: The spec on 1f6s.com has been updated (remote v{remote}, local v{local}).
app.banner.no_engine: ffmpeg/ffprobe not found. Put the engines next to the program, or make sure ffmpeg is available on the system PATH.
app.error.spec_load: Failed to load the compression spec: {error}
app.error.spec_missing: Cannot find the spec file assets/spec/levels.json
app.title: 1f6s Desktop Compressor
compress.action.cancel_tip: Remove from the queue or cancel the running task
compress.error.no_engine: ffmpeg/ffprobe not found; cannot read the video info.
compress.status.added: Added {n} task(s); the queue runs them one by one.
compress.status.ready: Ready. Pick videos, then press Start compression; tasks run one by one.
compress.status.staged: Selected {n} video(s); add more, or press Start compression to run.
settings.engines.hint: Leave empty for the built-in lookup (next to the program, then the system PATH). Restart to apply.
settings.language.hint: Restart the app to apply the language change.
settings.preset.hint: Non-slow presets encode faster but produce larger files (a deliberate deviation from the website's default command, recorded in AGENTS.md).
settings.priority.hint: Run ffmpeg with a lowered priority so foreground apps stay responsive.
settings.threads.hint: When > 0, "-threads N" is inserted before the last token of each encode command (a deliberate deviation from the website command, recorded in AGENTS.md).
